brief:
Israel's far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir said Israel would sell Palestinians to other nations to remove them from the country, Middle East Eye reported. Ben-Gvir made the statement in a video, though the exact context and timing were not specified in the available summary.

The remarks reflect hardline positions Ben-Gvir has taken since entering Israel's government coalition. His National Security Ministry oversees police forces in the occupied West Bank.
dek: Watch: Ben-Gvir says Israel would sell Palestinians to other countries Israel’s far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir says Israel would sell Palestinians to other countries to get rid of them.
title: Ben-Gvir says Israel would sell Palestinians to other countries
